data.name: Maharaj
data.gender_notes: Maharaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is greater than a king, a ruler of the universe. The name Maharaj carries the meaning “Great King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Maharaj usually hope their child will grow to embody great king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine ruler within, one who is in control of their mind, emotions and actions
data.etymology: Maharaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maharaj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Maharaj" holds significant cultural importance in the Hindu tradition. It is a title of respect and reverence, symbolizing power, authority, and wisdom. Maharajs were considered to be the embodiment of God on earth, holding immense power and influence over their subjects. They were believed to protect and govern their people with justice and fairness, upholding the dharma (cosmic order). The title was traditionally used for rulers, religious leaders, and spiritual teachers, signifying their exalted position in society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, a Maharaj can be seen as a representation of the divine ruler, the eternal, all-pervading consciousness. This title reminds us of the ultimate truth that there is a greater ruler of the universe, beyond our individual control and understanding. It encourages us to look within and seek the inner wisdom and compassion, as we strive to be the best versions of ourselves. The title inspires us to serve, protect, and uplift others, just as a Maharaj would do. Thus, the title "Maharaj" holds powerful spiritual significance, reminding us of our true nature as divine beings and our responsibility to act in the highest good of all.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Maharaj: Great King, Divine Ruler, one who serves as a spiritual guide and ruler over the hearts and minds of his people.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Maharaj, a teacher in Bangalore, India, shares that their name Maharaj meaning "Great King" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
